description: This file defines the CreateTestDatabaseCommand class, which is a Symfony console command used to create and initialize a test database, including dropping the existing database, creating a new one, importing SQL dump data, and generating fixtures for testing purposes.

classes.name: CreateTestDatabaseCommand
classes.description: A Symfony console command class for creating a test database in the OrangeHRM system, handling database creation, data import from dump, and fixture setup.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the console command, setting its description and defining input options for database user, password, and dump options.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the command, setting up the SymfonyStyle object for enhanced console output.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that creates the test database, imports data, and generates fixtures, handling errors and output messages.

methods.name: createTestDBConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a Doctrine DBAL Connection object to the test database with provided user and password.
